# Self-test harness for the project template.
#
# Each file cases/<case_name>.cmake is one test case. To add a case,
# add a new file. Do not edit this file.
#
# Usage:
#   cmake -S selftest -B build-selftest
#   ctest --test-dir build-selftest -j 8
# Each case has its own work directory, so the cases can run at the
# same time.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(project_template_selftest NONE)

enable_testing()

get_filename_component(SELFTEST_TEMPLATE_DIR
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)

file(GLOB SELFTEST_CASE_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cases/*.cmake")

# Register one CTest test for each case file.
# Each case gets its own work directory in the build tree.
function(selftest_register_case case_file)
  get_filename_component(case_name "${case_file}" NAME_WE)
  add_test(NAME ${case_name}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
      -DTEMPLATE_DIR=${SELFTEST_TEMPLATE_DIR}
      -DWORK_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/work/${case_name}
      -P ${case_file})
endfunction()

foreach(case_file IN LISTS SELFTEST_CASE_FILES)
  selftest_register_case("${case_file}")
endforeach()
